why_trail.why: Read global-crew.md/global-everyone.md doctrine; g4-implement-handoff.md in full; notes-666.md #675 verdict + slice provenance; coverage_675_verdict.json; G2/G3 modules (address.py/vocabulary.py/store.py/fit.py/frozen_constants.py) and test_fit.py fixture idioms; inspected real slice DB schema (2023 Q, rounds 6/7/10/12, drivers VER/PER/LEC/SAI, 6 classes incl k=4 severity, map_version varies per round so fit must be called with map_version=None). Located existing #625 F12 PASS artifact at docs/physics/625-f12-holdout-stability.json (post-#638 rework, n_pass=5/5) as the real provenance source for the vocab verdict -- Belgium not in its 22-circuit corpus, will be noted honestly. Handoff is complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present.

Wrote tests/unit/physics/fingerprint/test_bounded_validation.py with production_vocabulary() sourcing f12_verdict=PASS WITH PROVENANCE from the existing committed docs/physics/625-f12-holdout-stability.json (#625 Gate 3, post-#638 rework, n_pass=5/5) -- noted honestly that Belgium is absent from that artifact's 22-circuit corpus. Slice-connectivity test confirms rounds={6,7,10,12}, drivers={VER,PER,LEC,SAI}, classes=k4 severity set. require_fittable() does not raise (real PASS, no override needed). 4/4 tests green.

TestCutoffLeakageRealRounds: as_of_round=7 on the full real slice is byte-identical (mean/sigma/support_n/status/shared_floor_applied for all 4 drivers x 2 channels x k=4 classes) to as_of_round=7 on an independently-truncated copy (round_idx<=7 rows only) -- proves real future rounds 10 (Great Britain) and 12 (Belgium) are structurally excluded, not merely filtered-and-coincidentally-equal. as_of_round=12 differs from as_of_round=7 (more real rounds visible) -- cutoff is load-bearing. 2/2 green.

TestExactlyKCellsUnresolvedAndBothChannels: every (driver,channel) real fit returns exactly k=4 cells, never missing. Measured c1 (thin cell) threshold-crossing on real data: at as_of_round=6/7 (Monaco/Spain only) c1 has ZERO in-cutoff support -> unresolved for all 4 drivers; at as_of_round=10/12 (Great Britain/Belgium added) c1 support recency-decays to ~4.9/~3.77 -> crosses the 1.0 floor -> resolved for all 4 drivers. Reported per-driver, no blind assert either way. Both channels populated with >=1 resolved cell at as_of_round=12. 5/5 green.

TestSigmaWideningIdempotentOnRealThinCells: rerunning the full real-data fit into the SAME store leaves row_count==k (no duplicate accumulation) and byte-identical mean/sigma (no cross-run double-widening of the thin c1 cell's shared_floor). Rerunning into two independent fresh stores from the same real slice is also byte-identical. 2/2 green.

TestClassAxisSharedFloorRealData: var_circuit>0 for both channels on real data (utilization + energy), shared_floor_applied truthy on every resolved real cell. Direct proof the floor kwarg passed to pool_random_effects equals sqrt(captured var_circuit) exactly for every resolved cell in each channel (never a value drawing on var_team, the driver axis) -- this IS the structural 'driver-overall NOT floored' guarantee, verified on real numbers not just read from source. 2/2 green.
